title: Art Card-Art Identity
description: Shared art direction for the non-hero gameplay cards (units, pets, buildings, tactics, equipment, workers): the style, one palette and effect per element, and the framing of each category. Individual art cards point at a gameplay card by cardId and take its name, element and lore from there.

style.description: Rendering style shared by all card art

elements.description: Element name -> palette and effect (Neutral included)

categories.description: Category (units, pets, buildings, tactics, equipment, workers) -> framing and background
